title: AI assistants for teachers
why: AI can draft lesson plans, differentiated worksheets and quiz questions in minutes, giving time back for teaching.
what_is_different: Teachers must align AI output to the curriculum, the age group and their students' needs — and check every fact. Student data must not be shared.

extra_modules.title: Differentiation
extra_modules.outcome: You can: adapt one lesson for different levels
extra_modules.practice: Produce three versions of a worksheet for one objective

starter_project: Plan a two-week unit with AI help: objectives aligned to your curriculum, differentiated activities, a quiz with answer key — all checked and edited by you.
pitfalls: Content not matched to the local curriculum
Factual errors passed on to students
Sharing student names or work with AI tools

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
